Summary: Checks your Microsoft Intune tenant for anomalies in device protection, compliance, enrollment and policy settings. The checks grow with each release.

Prerequisites.Text: PowerShell 7.4 or later and Maester 3.0 or later.
An account that can read Intune and, for the BitLocker and LAPS checks, read BitLocker keys and LAPS password metadata (the Global Reader role is enough; so is Intune Administrator).

Steps.Text: Connect to Microsoft Graph with Maester's scopes plus the two this pack also needs. Maester's own scope check then passes, so no extra switch is needed.

Notes: If access is denied (a missing scope or a missing role), the BitLocker and LAPS checks are skipped with the reason, and the other checks run.

Options.Name: MP.RKS.IA.1001 IncludeExcludedDevices
Options.Text: Also list devices that a BitLocker policy leaves out on purpose.

Options.Name: MP.RKS.IA.1002 MaximumBackupAgeDays
Options.Text: A LAPS backup older than this is stale.

Options.Name: MP.RKS.IA.1002 IncludeExcludedDevices
Options.Text: Also list devices that a LAPS policy leaves out on purpose.

Options.Name: MP.RKS.IA.1004 InactiveDays
Options.Text: A device that has not synced for longer is inactive.

AppOnly.Text: Give the app the application permissions listed below, connect with Connect-MgGraph, and run Invoke-Maester -Pack RKS.IA -SkipBuiltIn -SkipGraphConnect -NonInteractive (-SkipGraphConnect skips Maester's check for its own Graph permissions, which an app made for this pack alone does not hold).
